title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic indoor selfie portrait of a young adult East Asian woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, posing naturally in a modern apartment or bedroom. Capture the scene in a vertical, intimate medium-close composition, framed from the top of her head to her lower torso, with her face positioned slightly right of center and her upper body filling most of the foreground. The camera is held at arm’s length, slightly above eye level, angled gently downward, creating the relaxed, personal atmosphere of a high-quality smartphone selfie.

She has a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a slender tapered jawline, a petite straight nose with a softly rounded tip, and naturally full, delicately defined rose-pink lips held slightly parted in a subtle, relaxed expression. Her large, expressive dark brown almond-shaped eyes feature fine brown eyeliner, softly defined upper eyelashes, subtle peach-brown eyeshadow, and luminous natural catchlights. Her eyebrows are neatly shaped and partially concealed beneath wispy, eyebrow-length bangs. Her fair ivory complexion has soft peach-pink undertones, delicate rosy blush across her cheeks, smooth yet realistic skin texture, and gentle natural highlights.

Her dark chocolate-brown hair has subtle warm chestnut undertones and is gathered into a casual low updo behind her head. Soft, airy, straight bangs fall across her forehead, while delicate loose strands frame her cheeks and ears. She tilts her head noticeably toward one shoulder, gazing directly into the camera with a gentle, calm, slightly inquisitive expression.

She has a slender, naturally curvaceous figure with a defined waist, softly rounded shoulders, and harmonious feminine proportions. She wears a fitted, light taupe-gray ribbed knit T-shirt featuring a modest high mock neckline, short cap sleeves, and a close-fitting silhouette that follows the natural contours of her torso. The fine horizontal knit texture and subtle fabric tension are clearly visible. Both arms extend forward toward the camera in a natural selfie-taking pose, with her forearms partially cropped by the frame. No jewelry or additional accessories are visible.

Behind her is a contemporary interior featuring large dark charcoal and black sliding wardrobe panels, intersected by narrow silver metallic trim and a broad horizontal light-gray accent strip. A small portion of warm honey-colored wooden flooring appears in the lower-left background. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates her face from the front-left, producing gentle shadows, realistic skin luminosity, and balanced exposure.

Shot with a premium smartphone camera, approximately 26mm equivalent focal length, natural perspective, crisp facial detail, subtle background softness, realistic fabric texture, cinematic yet understated color grading, warm neutral tones, restrained contrast, and authentic photographic realism. Preserve natural anatomy, believable proportions, fine individual hair strands, realistic skin pores, and an intimate candid selfie aesthetic. Aspect ratio 9:16.
